item.title: HSE Delivers Over 2,000 Flu Vaccines To MidWest Nursing Homes
item.description: Over 2,000 flu vaccines have now been delivered to nursing homes and long-term care facilities in the MidWest region. New HSE figures show there’s been uptake rate of 88% across Clare, Limerick and North Tipperary. The programme is running until February. Vaccinator Nora Mullane is hopeful of getting more centres on board. The post HSE Delivers Over 2,000 Flu Vaccines To MidWest Nursing Homes appeared first on Clare FM.

item.title: Over 22,000 Patients Treated On Trolleys At UHL In 2025
item.description: Over 22,000 patients were treated on trolleys at University Hospital Limerick throughout 2025.
